description: Gates that only apply when the run declares them, because a single-locale site and one whose translations are not built yet are indistinguishable in source. Open the run with --flag international or --flag local to bring these in.

gates.title: hreflang Covers Every Locale And x-default
gates.rule: Every locale points at every other, and an x-default catches the rest. A set without x-default sends a visitor whose locale is unlisted nowhere in particular.
gates.fix: Emit the full reciprocal set on every localised route, including x-default.

gates.title: Locale Codes Are Well Formed
gates.rule: Each hreflang is a two-letter language, optionally with a two-letter region in caps. A malformed code is not partially honoured - the whole annotation is dropped.
gates.fix: Correct each code to the language or language-REGION form.

gates.title: One Phone Number Across The Site
gates.rule: Name, address and phone appear identically everywhere. Citations are matched on exact strings, so a second phone number splits one business into two as far as the match is concerned.
gates.fix: Move the contact details into one constant and render every appearance from it.

gates.title: LocalBusiness Markup Is Complete
gates.rule: A LocalBusiness node carrying address, telephone, openingHours and geo. A node missing any of them is a partial answer to the question a local result is built from.
gates.fix: Add the missing properties from the same source the rendered contact block uses.
